validated_objective: Deliver QIF v0.8.18 as an executable, auditable extension of skill-supply-chain for quarantine outcome and safe re-entry evidence
scope: Quarantine outcome and containment observation records
Incident replay validations and observation windows
Residual risk and governance-owned re-entry assessments
constraints: No live quarantine, remediation, dependency restart, permission mutation, credential use, or external integration
Examples remain example-only and structural validation cannot prove containment effectiveness or safety
expected_outcomes: All recovery and re-entry references, counts, state transitions, and timing arithmetic are deterministic
Incomplete, unverified, failed replay, insufficient observation, or high residual risk produces governance-required rather than ready
